From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Quick finance note here — we should be conservative on provisional caps until the commercial SOW lands. Recommend:

- Temporary provisional cap: $50,000 (USD) for first 90 days.
- PO numbering: issue a provisional PO number with "PROV-" prefix (finance will reconcile when final PO assigned).
- Line items: please ensure separate SKU lines for "Integration (service)" and "API usage credits". We prefer quantity/pricing fields for the integration line and a not-to-exceed monthly block for usage, to keep spend tracking accurate.

Also flagging a common pitfall: in previous onboarding we saw duplicate spend where usage credits were pre-billed and then again reconciled under consumption — separate SKU codes prevent that. If procurement can ask GreenTap to re-send the W-9 with full Tax ID and include a brief sample invoice that maps to the two line items, Finance will expedite provisional issuance.

— Karthik
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Alice / team —

Thanks for the updated W-9 (received earlier today) and the sample invoice — appreciate the quick turnaround. Per procurement + finance alignment we've issued a provisional purchase reference: PROV-45871.

What we did:
- Created provisional PO: PROV-45871 (see attachment GT_PO_45871_v1.pdf)
- Split line items per request:
  1) Integration professional services — SKU: GT-INT-001 — Qty 1 — Unit: $12,000
  2) API usage credits — SKU: GT-API-100 — NTE (monthly block) $8,000

Note: Finance flagged an ambiguity in the initial line-item totals that would cause double-counting of usage credits if GreenTap bills a monthly invoice and we also pre-allocate credits under a separate ledger. We corrected the provisional PO to show the usage line as a not-to-exceed monthly allowance rather than a pre-billed lump sum. Please review the attached v1 and v2 (we pushed a minor correction to line 2 formatting).

Next steps for GreenTap:
- Confirm you accept PROV-45871 and the line-item split. Reply with a one-line acceptance and attach the first sample invoice (so we can map it against SKU codes).
- Legal will convert PROV-45871 to a final PO number once the SOW is signed — finance will reconcile all provisional charges to the final PO mapping.

Attachments: GT_PO_45871_v1.pdf (PDF stub), GT_PO_45871_v2.pdf (PDF stub)

If there's anything else you'd like changed to match your billing cadence, flag it now and we'll update the provisional PO.

Best,
